words.example: Mark his late arrival on the paper list before you file it.
words.exampleZh: 归档之前，请在纸质名单上标明他迟到了。

words.example: She asked for early leave at three for a school appointment.
words.exampleZh: 她申请三点早退，要去学校办事。

words.example: He left his proxy vote with the chair just before the flight.
words.exampleZh: 他临上飞机之前，把代投票交给了主持人。

words.example: There is a fresh motion to hold the all-staff meeting on Friday.
words.exampleZh: 有一项新动议，建议把全员大会放到周五。

words.example: I second the motion to extend.
The credential leak came from a spreadsheet mailed to the vendor last week.
words.exampleZh: 这次凭据泄露来自上周寄给厂商的一份表格。

words.example: A keylogger on the registration PC captured passwords until Defender removed it.
words.exampleZh: 挂号电脑上的键盘记录一直在抓密码，直到系统防护把它清掉。

words.example: Screen capture on the billing PC recorded card numbers until we blocked the tool.
words.exampleZh: 收费电脑上的屏幕截取一直在录卡号，直到我们封掉那个工具。

words.example: Malware read the clipboard on the billing PC and stole a copied card number.
words.exampleZh: 恶意程序读了收费电脑的剪贴板，偷走一个刚复制的卡号。

words.example: A USB drop in the lobby parking lot is how that worm reached a clinic PC.
words.exampleZh: 大厅停车场的一次 U 盘投放，就是那只蠕虫进到门诊电脑的途径。
